findings.title: Cancel imminent reminders without waiting for the cron job
findings.body: Scheduled emails are now only marked cancelled, even when their send time is before the next 15-minute cron run. For example, an email due at 10:10 for a booking cancelled at 10:01 after the 10:00 run will still be sent. At 10:15, scheduleEmailReminders deletes the expired reminder before attempting cancellation, so it never contacts SendGrid for that email. Reminders close to their send time need an immediate cancellation path.

findings.title: Do not bypass deferred cancellation for every reschedule
findings.body: Passing immediateDelete=true cancels every old rescheduled-booking email immediately in SendGrid, including emails scheduled days ahead. Those cancellations remain pending until their original send dates and consume the same 100-pending-cancellation limit identified in this PR. Once that limit is reached, the helper catches the failure without setting cancelled=true, leaving the old reminder scheduled with no cron retry. Rescheduling therefore still exhausts the cancellation quota and sends obsolete reminders.

findings.title: Isolate cancellation failures and persist each successful cancellation
findings.body: The entire cancellation loop shares one try/catch, and its Prisma deletes are lazy promises executed only after every SendGrid request succeeds. If any request fails, all later reminders are skipped and none of the earlier successful cancellations are removed from the database. A persistent failure can consequently block unrelated cancellations on every run until their emails are sent. Handle errors per reminder and execute each database deletion after its corresponding successful cancellation.

findings.title: Await reminder cancellation before completing the booking cancellation
findings.body: The reminder helpers now perform the database update or deletion themselves, but their returned promises are discarded by the nested forEach calls. Previously, database reminder deletions were included in the awaited Promise.all. The handler can now report a successful cancellation while its cancelled flags or unscheduled-reminder deletions are still pending; in a serverless request those operations can be interrupted after the response, leaving reminders eligible to be sent. Collect and await these helper promises, including the equivalent requestReschedule calls.
